title: Judge-only compare-suite ground truth
description: Oracle and scoring contract for one compare suite. Solvers must never read this file. The verifier allows suite-specific extensions but requires enough structure for blind judging and trajectory attribution.

note.description: Must state that this file is judge-only / hidden from solvers.

sharedScoring.description: Suite-wide scoring rubric when per-question scoring is intentionally shared.

answer.description: Judge-only oracle answer. Use oracle instead when the answer is computed at run time.

oracle.description: Run-time oracle or parity oracle. Use answer when the exact value is stable.

scoring.description: Per-question 1.0/0.5/0 rubric. May be omitted only when sharedScoring exists at suite level.

capabilityPoint.description: Differentiating capability / trajectory condition this question is meant to exercise.
